nodes.description: External caller address; drives all authorization checks (allow/onlyOwner/onlyAdmin) and holder identity.
Block timestamp / now used for time dependent logic such as bounty windows, rotations and schain creation.
Low-level call forwarding all available gas and value to an arbitrary recipient inside Address.sendValue.
External ERC20/777 transfer of earned bounty to an arbitrary destination address.
External ERC20/777 transfer of accumulated validator fees.
External IMintableToken.mint call to the Distributor which fires the ERC777 recipient hook.
Loop performing external calls to every registered locker contract while accumulating locked balances.
External call into DelegationController.processAllSlashes before returning the locked amount.
Chained multiplication and division used to derive the schain price from deposits and constants.
Arithmetic decrement of the epoch pool and increment of the paid counter after bounty computation.
ERC777 recipient hook that decodes userData and triggers Schains.addSchain on an external contract.
External Punisher.handleSlash invocation performed while processing accumulated slashing penalties.
Library function that sends native value with an unchecked low-level call instead of transfer.
Allows a holder to withdraw earned bounty after the lockup period, transferring tokens out.
Allows a validator to withdraw earned fees after the lockup period.
Entry point computing and paying a node bounty; validates node existence and reward timing.
Private function minting bounty tokens to the Distributor through the SkaleToken contract.
Sums and updates locked amounts across all registered locker contracts for a holder.
Slashes a validator by calling DelegationController.confiscate; restricted to the SkaleDKG contract.
Admin-only function reducing a holder's locked amount after all slashes are processed.
Increments the locked amount of a holder; callable only by the DelegationController.
Processes all pending slashes for a wallet and returns its locked token amount.
Creates a schain from caller supplied data; validates timing, lifetime and deposit.
Computes the SKL deposit required for a schain type and lifetime.
Calculates the ordinary bounty of a node, refilling the epoch pool and mutating internal counters.
Creates a delegation proposal, verifying periods, validator authorization and holder balance.
Aggregates slashing signals and forwards penalties to the Punisher contract.
Registers a new node, validating IP, name, port and public key ownership.
Checks validator authorization and that the validator meets the minimum staking requirement.
ERC777 recipient hook receiving tokens and userData to create a schain.
Pseudo-randomly selects nodes for a schain group using blockhash based randomness.
Records a monitoring verdict, using block.timestamp to enforce the verdict window.
Pseudo-randomly selects a replacement node for a schain and updates node/space state.
Mapping of token holder to locked (slashable) token amount.
Array of all delegations used as delegation identifier index.
Mapping of holder to launch locked token amount queried by TokenState.

edges.reason: slash authorization is derived from msg.sender being the trusted SkaleDKG contract
handleSlash is gated by the allow(DelegationController) modifier evaluated on msg.sender
delegate records msg.sender as the delegation holder and checks it against limits
createNode uses msg.sender as node owner and public key owner
locked amount aggregation is keyed by the address supplied by the caller path
bounty payout depends on now compared to the next reward timestamp
verdict acceptance window is enforced with block.timestamp
schain creation is gated by now >= schainCreationTimeStamp
sendValue executes the unchecked low-level value call with forwarded gas
the arbitrary recipient can reenter the caller of sendValue during the value transfer
withdrawBounty performs the external token transfer after computing the amount
a malicious token can reenter Distributor accounting during transfer
withdrawFee performs the external token transfer of validator fees
a malicious token can reenter Distributor accounting during fee transfer
getBounty pays the computed bounty through _payBounty
getBounty obtains the amount from BountyV2.calculateBounty
_payBounty invokes the external mint on the token contract
the ERC777 mint hook reenters the manager/distributor flow
getAndUpdateLockedAmount loops over lockers performing external calls
a locker contract can reenter TokenState while amounts are being accumulated
_getAndUpdateLockedAmount externally triggers processAllSlashes before returning
processAllSlashes can invoke handleSlash and reenter Punisher state
getSchainPrice evaluates chained unchecked multiplication and division
calculateBounty subtracts the paid bounty from the epoch pool
delegate settles pending slashing signals before completing
_sendSlashingSignals makes an external handleSlash call into Punisher
tokensReceived decodes userData and invokes an external contract to create a schain
attacker controlled userData flows into Schains.addSchain parameters
createNode validates the sender through checkPossibilityCreatingNode
checkPossibilityCreatingNode reads delegation totals to enforce the staking requirement
forgive reads and decreases the holder locked balance
handleSlash increases the holder locked balance
slash ultimately affects locked balances of the slashed validator delegations
slash calls confiscate which eventually emits slashing signals handled by handleSlash
delegate pushes a new delegation entry into the delegations array
TokenState queries the TokenLaunchLocker locked balances during aggregation
createNode appends a new node structure to the nodes array

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter belongs to the Address.sendValue function that performs the low-level value call
amount parameter belongs to the Address.sendValue function performing the value transfer
destination address is only meaningful inside Distributor.withdrawBounty token transfer
validatorId selects the bounty accounting used by Distributor.withdrawBounty
local bounty value is computed and transferred by Distributor.withdrawBounty
holder parameter indexes the locked mapping modified by Punisher.forgive
amount parameter is subtracted from the locked balance in Punisher.forgive
nodeIndex parameter drives the checks and payment of SkaleManager.getBounty
local bounty value is produced by the reward calculation in SkaleManager.getBounty
schain type selects the node count and divisor in Schains.getSchainPrice
lifetime parameter is multiplied into the price formula in Schains.getSchainPrice
numerator local variable is the product of the unchecked arithmetic in the price computation
nodeIndex parameter determines which reward timestamp is checked in BountyV2.calculateBounty
local bounty value is subtracted from the epoch pool, the arithmetic mutation of the function
amount parameter is added to the holder locked balance in Punisher.handleSlash
holder parameter drives the locker loop inside TokenState.getAndUpdateLockedAmount
running locked total is accumulated by the external locker loop, the unsafe operation
